seo.title: Company
seo.seo_title: Nexora AI: AI for Quebec small businesses
seo.seo_description: Nexora AI, a Quebec company: the leading edge of AI, simple and under your control. Services, new products with their real status, commitments on your data.

blocks.role: Mission de Nexora AI (la pointe de l'IA, simple, sous votre contrôle, d'ici), limitée à ce qui est connu.

translation.headline: The leading edge of AI, simple and local.
translation.subheadline: Nexora AI is a Quebec company. Our mission: to put the leading edge of AI within reach of local small businesses, simply and under their control, so that their data stays theirs.

blocks.role: La mission en quatre idées : pointe, simplicité, contrôle, d'ici.

translation.title: Our mission, in four ideas.
translation.body: Cutting-edge AI should not require a team of specialists, or giving up your data. That is what we are building.

items.title: The leading edge of AI.
items.text: Agents that use your tools, an assistant that builds a workflow (an automated sequence of tasks) from a description in plain French, answers grounded in your documents, reading of scanned documents, voice, model comparison. These are words of ambition: the proof is the list of what the tool does.

items.title: Simple for everyone.
items.text: No code to write: you describe the need, review, approve. We install, we run it, and we train your team in usage and supervision.

items.title: Under your control.
items.text: A person decides on anything that commits the business. Your data stays on your premises or in Quebec, is never used to train a model and is never sold. See the commitments on your data.

items.title: Local.
items.text: A Quebec company, working in French, that stays at your side after the installation.

blocks.role: Ce que fait Nexora AI : quatre verbes, en mosaïque.

cards.title: Design.
cards.text: AI systems fitted to your trade, not a catalogue of gadgets. We start with one concrete problem, then extend without multiplying disconnected tools.

cards.title: Install.
cards.text: On your server, or in our infrastructure in Quebec.

cards.title: Integrate.
cards.text: By connecting the software you already use.

cards.title: Support.
cards.text: By running the system with you and training your team in usage and supervision.

blocks.role: Les trois nouveautés, chacune en une phrase avec son statut honnête.

translation.title: Three novelties, each with its status.
translation.intro: Words of ambition never replace the real state of things: here is where each one stands.

cards.title: Nexora Croissance.
cards.text: Nexora Croissance, our automated marketing service: a website with hosting included, search visibility, online advertising, social media and reputation tracking. Status: early access, on request.

cards.title: Nexora Vision.
cards.text: AI video surveillance, designed to analyze images on a server installed on your premises. Status: pilot project by invitation only; no installation exists yet.

cards.title: Your data.
cards.text: Our commitments: your data stays on your premises or in Quebec, is never used to train a model and is never sold. The documents that make them verifiable are in preparation.

cards.title: Truth first.
cards.text: We publish no testimonial, no figure and no certification that we cannot prove. When a capability is in pilot or planned, we write it.

cards.title: Control, within the flows we configure.
cards.text: In the workflows we set up, any action that commits the business waits for a person's approval, unless you decide otherwise in writing.

cards.title: Reversibility.
cards.text: Your documents, configurations and workflows stay exportable, and the contract provides for it.

cards.title: One case at a time.
cards.text: One concrete problem, put into service and verified, before expanding. No universal timeline is announced.

blocks.role: Ce que le lecteur peut vérifier.

translation.title: What you can verify.
translation.body: A company is judged by what it lets you check. Here is where to look.

items.title: A status for every capability.
items.text: Each product and each department shows whether it is available, in pilot or planned, for example on the OPSYS-AI page. Nexora Croissance is in early access and Nexora Vision is a pilot project by invitation.

items.title: A register of proofs.
items.text: The sensitive claims on this site are kept in an internal register, with their evidence, source and version.

items.title: Commitments on your data.
items.text: They are set out, with their limits, on the Your data page.

items.title: Documents on request.
items.text: The trust center lists the documents we are preparing and their status.

blocks.role: Joindre Nexora AI : le formulaire, rien d'autre d'inventé.

translation.title: Get in touch.
translation.body: The simplest way is the contact form: describe one concrete problem, and we will reply with what is feasible and where to start. Would you rather begin with a structured conversation? Plan a diagnosis.

translation.title: Let's talk about your first case.
translation.text: Describe a concrete problem. We will tell you what is feasible, in which mode, and where to start.
